findings.title: Successful charge can leave idempotency key stuck in-flight if local completion fails
findings.evidence: After the gateway call succeeds, the code writes the receipt to the local store without any cleanup path if that write raises. In that case the key remains in '_in_flight', and every retry will hit the duplicate-in-flight error forever even though the provider may already have charged the customer.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the post-charge persistence step so that failures do not leave the key permanently reserved. For example, catch exceptions from 'store.complete', call 'store.abandon(idempotency_key)' before re-raising, or make completion atomic/durable so retries can recover the original receipt instead of being blocked indefinitely.
